description: This file contains the implementation of the TableDnD jQuery plugin, enabling drag-and-drop functionality for table rows, including options for hierarchy levels, styling, and event callbacks.

methods.name: parseStyle
methods.description: Parses a CSS string into an object map of style properties.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Initializes drag-and-drop on tables with specific data attributes, merging user options with defaults.

methods.name: makeIndented
methods.description: Prepares table rows for hierarchy indentation based on data levels.

methods.name: makeDraggable
methods.description: Makes table rows draggable, optionally using a handle.

methods.name: currentOrder
methods.description: Returns a string representing the current order of rows.

methods.name: initialiseDrag
methods.description: Begins the drag operation, capturing mouse offsets and binding move/end events.

methods.name: updateTables
methods.description: Reinitializes drag-and-drop on all tables.

methods.name: mouseCoords
methods.description: Gets mouse coordinates from an event, supporting touch and mouse events.

methods.name: getMouseOffset
methods.description: Calculates the mouse offset relative to a target element.

methods.name: getPosition
methods.description: Calculates the position of an element in the document.

methods.name: autoScroll
methods.description: Automatically scrolls the window when dragging near edges.

methods.name: moveVerticle
methods.description: Moves a row vertically based on drag direction.

methods.name: moveHorizontal
methods.description: Moves a row horizontally to support hierarchy levels.

methods.name: mousemove
methods.description: Handles the mouse move event during dragging, updating row positions.

methods.name: findDragDirection
methods.description: Determines drag direction based on mouse movement.

methods.name: findDropTargetRow
methods.description: Finds the target row for dropping based on Y position.

methods.name: processMouseup
methods.description: Handles the drop action, cleaning up and triggering callbacks.

methods.name: mouseup
methods.description: Handles mouseup event to finalize dragging.

methods.name: jsonize
methods.description: Serializes table data into JSON format.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes table data into URL-encoded string.

methods.name: serializeTable
methods.description: Serializes a single table's row IDs.

methods.name: serializeTables
methods.description: Serializes all tables' data.

methods.name: tableData
methods.description: Extracts hierarchical data from a table for serialization.
